 About England vs South Africa Bowl Final
 The England vs South Africa Bowl Final in the HK Sixes, 2026 delivered an exciting contest at Mission Road Ground, Mong Kok on 01 November 2026, with both teams showcasing strong performances with bat and ball. Batting first, England put up 95/6 (6.0) on the board, thanks to a solid knock from Ed Barnard, who scored 35 runs, while Jack Carson provided valuable support. In reply, South Africa fought hard and reached 101/1 (5.1), with Blake Simpson leading the chase with an important contribution. With the ball, Abdullah Bayoumy and Fynn Hudson-Prentice made a significant impact by picking up crucial wickets and controlling the run flow at key moments. This stats page gives fans a complete breakdown of batting and bowling performances, partnerships, strike rates, economy rates, and key match moments from the HK Sixes, 2026, helping readers understand how the game unfolded.
